properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BearSSL's 3DES surface, confirmed object-wide: deprecated 3DES-EDE-CBC-SHA suites wired into every default "full" client/server profile (ECDHE-ECDSA/RSA, static ECDH, RSA-KEX variants) plus the brssl tool's suite registry rows and twrch wiring. 23 of 31 sites judged individually; the remainder are the same class (names.c registry rows for ECDHE-RSA/ECDH-ECDSA 3DES suites, twrch engine wiring). 3DES offers ~112-bit security and is deprecated (SP 800-131A); its suites' key exchanges are additional

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 8 sites individually confirmed: BearSSL ships a single-DES CBC engine API (bearssl_ssl.h), a default DES-CBC selector (ssl_engine_default_descbc.c) and wires it into the default full client/server profiles and the twrch tool. Deprecated 56-bit-class cipher offered by the shipped library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BearSSL's AES-CBC cipher-suite surface: suite constants wired into the default full client/server profiles (ECDHE-ECDSA/RSA AES-128/256-CBC with SHA-256/SHA-384/SHA-1 MACs) and the CBC record-protection wiring. CBC-with-MAC records (Lucky13-class padding-oracle exposure class); the suites' ECDHE/ECDH/RSA key exchanges are quantum-vulnerable. Sampled sites uniform across ssl_client_full.c, ssl_server_full_*.c, ssl_keyexport.c, bearssl headers; unjudged sites are the same class.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BearSSL's Poly1305 MAC surface: public API declarations (br_poly1305_ctmul/ctmul32/i15/ctmulq run functions in bearssl_block.h) and the ChaCha20-Poly1305 record-protection wiring (bearssl_ssl.h). Symmetric MAC — not Shor-vulnerable, part of the shipped AEAD construction. Sampled sites uniform (API decls + engine wiring); unjudged sites are the same class.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 5 sites individually confirmed: secp256k1 is recognized in the brssl tool's curve-name registry and the ta (trust-anchor) tool's curve-ID switch. BearSSL defines BR_EC_secp256k1 but its default EC providers (all_m15/all_m31/prime_i15/prime_i31) do not implement it — a name-mapping surface only. Shor-vulnerable curve if ever used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 3 sites individually confirmed: self-signed test PKI generated with the openssl CLI — ECDSA P-256 (prime256v1) for grpc and http tests, RSA-4096 for ws tests, all with 3650-day validity and CN=localhost. Quantum-vulnerable certificate signatures (migrate to ML-DSA); test-only, not production trust.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 3 sites individually confirmed: POWER8 AES-CTR/CBC-MAC instantiation macros (MKCBCMAC 128/192/256) — the CBC-MAC half of BearSSL's GCM building blocks, including a non-standard AES-192 variant. Shipped MAC surface of the library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Both sites individually confirmed: br_sha224_init declaration (bearssl_hash.h) and implementation (hash/sha2small.c) — the shipped library's SHA-224 digest, a legacy 112-bit-collision-resistance variant.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BearSSL's ECDHE/ECDH key-agreement surface: engine state fields (ecdhe_curve, ecdhe_key[70], ecdhe_point[133]), API accessors (br_ssl_engine_get_ecdhe_curve) and the EC implementations behind them. All elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman key agreement is Shor-vulnerable — harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure on every TLS session; migrate to hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768. The sampled sites are uniform shipped-library surface (fields, declarations, dispatch) across bearssl_ssl.h, brssl.h and the ec/ implementa

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BearSSL's P-256 (secp256r1) surface: implementation dispatch (ec_all_m15/m31), prime-field curve parameters, and PKCS#10 CSR generation (bre_pkcs10.c) with ECDH/ECDSA on P-256. Quantum-vulnerable EC key agreement and signatures; migrate key agreement to ML-KEM-768 and signatures to ML-DSA-65. Sampled sites uniform library implementation surface; unjudged sites same class.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BearSSL's X25519 (Curve25519) key-agreement surface: implementation dispatch (ec_all_m15/ec_all_m31 routers) plus the underlying Curve25519 implementations. 9 of 17 sites judged individually; remainder are the same class (additional dispatch cases / implementation references). X25519 ECDH is Shor-vulnerable — harvest-now-decrypt-later; migrate to ML-KEM-768 (hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 in TLS).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 12 sites individually confirmed: brssl tool suite-name registry rows for the ECDHE-ECDSA suite family (ChaCha20-Poly1305, AES-GCM/CCM/CCM_8/CBC, 3DES variants) — the runtime-selectable TLS suite surface; ECDHE key exchange and ECDSA authentication are both Shor-vulnerable (migrate to hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 / ML-DSA-65).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BearSSL's P-384/P-521 surface: curve parameter tables (ec_prime_i15/i31), implementation dispatch and PKCS#10 CSR support. Quantum-vulnerable EC key agreement/signatures; migrate to ML-KEM-768 / ML-DSA-65. Sampled sites uniform; unjudged sites same class.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Both sites individually confirmed: "curve448"/"c448" registry entries mapping to BR_EC_curve448 in the brssl tool — runtime-selectable X448 ECDH key agreement; Shor-vulnerable, migrate to ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BearSSL's AES-128 surface: AES-128-GCM/CCM/CBC suite constants wired into the default full client/server profiles and the AES-128 implementations behind them. Symmetric cipher not Shor-vulnerable, but the suites' ECDHE/ECDH/RSA key exchanges are. Sampled sites uniform suite constants; unjudged sites same class.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BearSSL's AES-GCM surface: AEAD suite constants (ECDHE-ECDSA/RSA, ECDH static, AES-128/256-GCM) in the default full client/server profiles plus the GCM record-protection wiring (GHASH selection, key export). AEAD is the strongest record protection in the library; the suites' key exchanges remain quantum-vulnerable. Sampled sites uniform; unjudged sites same class.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Both sites individually confirmed: br_sha256_init declaration (bearssl_hash.h) and implementation (hash/sha2small.c) — the shipped library's core SHA-256 digest (TLS PRF, suite MACs, X.509 hashing).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BearSSL's AES-256 surface: AES-256-GCM/CCM/CBC suite constants in the default full client/server profiles and AES-256 implementations. Symmetric cipher not Shor-vulnerable; the suites' key exchanges are. Sampled sites uniform; unjudged sites same class.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Both sites individually confirmed: project READMEs document PostgreSQL connections with "ssl true" — TLS-enabled DB connections per documentation; libpq ssl=true without sslmode=verify-full is opportunistic TLS without certificate pinning.
